lede_zh: 模型大到一定程度，难处就从训练挪到了使用。每往外写一个词，都要把前面所有词的键和值从显存里再读一遍。这一室的展品大多在省这一笔：少存一点，少读几次，少看几个位置。
lede_en: Past a certain size, the hard part of a model moves from training it to running it. For each word it writes, the keys and values of every earlier word must be read from GPU memory again. Most exhibits in this room save on that bill: store less, read fewer times, look at fewer positions.

sections.text_zh:
Shazeer 在 2019 年就把这个问题讲清楚了。训练的时候整条序列可以一起算，一个词一个词往外写的时候不行：每一步都要把很大的键张量和值张量重新加载一遍，速度卡在显存的带宽上。他提出多查询注意力，让所有的头共用同一组键和值，解码快了很多，质量只掉一点点。

下文要等到四年以后。2023 年的 GQA 取了个中间值：键值头不止一组，但比查询头少。作者还给了一个改造旧模型的办法，只花原先预训练 5% 的算力，就能把一个训好的多头模型改成这种结构。
sections.text_en:
Shazeer set the problem out clearly in 2019. In training, a whole sequence is computed together. Writing one word at a time is different: each step reloads the large key and value tensors, and speed is capped by memory bandwidth. He proposed multi-query attention, in which all heads share one set of keys and values. Decoding became much faster and quality fell only slightly.

The follow-up came four years later. GQA, in 2023, took a middle value: more than one group of key-value heads, but fewer than the query heads. Its authors also gave a recipe for converting an existing model. With 5% of the original pretraining compute, a trained multi-head checkpoint can be turned into this form.

anchors.note_zh: 所有的头共用一组键和值，解码时少搬很多数据。
anchors.note_en: All heads share one set of keys and values, so decoding moves far less data.

anchors.note_zh: 键值头分成几组，介于「每头一组」和「全部共用」之间。
anchors.note_en: Key-value heads in a few groups: between one per head and one for all.

sections.text_zh:
FlashAttention 盯上的是另一种浪费。作者说，第六室那些近似的办法，纸面上的计算量是降了，放到机器上却常常快不起来。他们认为大家漏算了一项：数据在 GPU 的大块显存和芯片上的小块高速缓存之间来回读写，这才是真正花时间的地方。FlashAttention 把注意力切成小块来算，结果一位不差，读写的次数少了很多。

PagedAttention 管的是键值缓存怎么放。它借了操作系统给内存分页的老办法，把缓存切成一页一页的，按需分配，零碎的空位和重复的副本就少了。
sections.text_en:
FlashAttention went after a different kind of waste. Its authors noted that the approximations of Room 6 lower the cost on paper but often bring no speed-up on a real machine. What had been left out of the accounting, they argued, is the traffic between the GPU's large main memory and its small, fast on-chip memory. That traffic is where the time goes. FlashAttention computes attention in small tiles. The result is exact, and the reads and writes are far fewer.

PagedAttention deals with where the key-value cache is kept. It borrows paging, the old operating-system method for managing memory: the cache is cut into pages and handed out on demand, which leaves fewer gaps and fewer duplicate copies.

anchors.note_zh: 注意力照原样精确地算，只是切成小块，少读写几次显存。
anchors.note_en: Exact attention, computed in tiles so that GPU memory is read and written fewer times.

anchors.note_zh: 像操作系统管内存那样，一页一页地管键值缓存。
anchors.note_en: Manages the key-value cache in pages, the way an operating system manages memory.

sections.text_zh:
缓存本身也可以删、可以压。

H2O 发现，注意力分数的大头是由少数几个 token 贡献的，那么缓存里只留这几个和最近的一段就够了。StreamingLLM 试了更简单的做法，只留最近的一个窗口，结果文本一超过缓存的长度，模型就不行了。作者接着发现，只要把最开头那几个 token 的键和值留着，效果基本能找回来。他们管这几个 token 叫注意力汇点：它们自己未必有什么意思，却吸走了很高的注意力分数。

DeepSeek-V2 的多头潜在注意力是压而不是删，把键和值一起压进一个低维的潜在向量，键值缓存比 DeepSeek 67B 少用 93.3%。2025 年的 NSA 把两样合在一起，粗的一层压缩 token，细的一层挑选 token。以前的稀疏注意力大多是训练完了再套上去的，NSA 从训练的时候就这么算，设计时也照顾了硬件。
sections.text_en:
The cache itself can be trimmed, and it can be compressed.

H2O found that a few tokens contribute most of the attention score, so the cache need keep only those and the most recent stretch. StreamingLLM tried something simpler, keeping only a recent window, and the model broke down as soon as the text outgrew the cache. Its authors then found that keeping the keys and values of the first few tokens recovers most of what was lost. They named those tokens attention sinks: they may mean little in themselves, yet they draw very high attention scores.

Multi-head latent attention, in DeepSeek-V2, compresses instead of trimming. It packs keys and values together into a low-dimensional latent vector and uses 93.3% less key-value cache than DeepSeek 67B. NSA, in 2025, combines the two approaches: a coarse layer that compresses tokens and a fine layer that selects them. Earlier sparse attention was mostly applied after training. NSA computes this way from training onward, and was designed with the hardware in mind.

anchors.note_zh: 留住开头几个 token 和最近的一段，模型就能一直往下读。
anchors.note_en: Keep the first few tokens and the most recent stretch, and the model can keep reading indefinitely.

anchors.note_zh: 把键和值压进一个潜在向量，缓存小了九成多。
anchors.note_en: Packs keys and values into a latent vector. The cache shrinks by more than nine tenths.

anchors.note_zh: 稀疏注意力从训练时就用上：粗处压缩，细处挑选。
anchors.note_en: Sparse attention used from training onward: compress coarsely, select finely.

sections.text_zh:
还有人回过头去改 softmax 注意力本身。

Diff Transformer 认为，Transformer 把太多注意力分给了不相干的上下文。它算两张 softmax 注意力图，拿一张减另一张，两边共有的噪声就抵消了。2025 年的门控注意力做得更小：在注意力算完之后，给每个头加一个 sigmoid 门。作者认为它起作用有两个原因，门让注意力多了一层非线性，门的取值本身又很稀疏。他们还报告说，上面讲的注意力汇点，在加了门之后减轻了。

导览到这里结束。从 2014 年算起，这十几年里的展品，绝大多数改的都是第一室里的那三步：打分，加权，求和。
sections.text_en:
Others went back to softmax attention itself.

Diff Transformer argued that a Transformer spends too much attention on irrelevant context. It computes two softmax attention maps and subtracts one from the other, so the noise they share cancels out. Gated Attention, in 2025, makes a smaller change: after attention is computed, each head gets a sigmoid gate. Its authors give two reasons it works. The gate adds a non-linearity to attention, and the gate values are themselves sparse. They also report that the attention sinks described above grow weaker once the gate is added.

The tour ends here. Nearly every exhibit from 2014 to now changes the same three steps from Room 1: score, weight, sum.

anchors.note_zh: 两张注意力图相减，抵消掉分给无关内容的那部分。
anchors.note_en: Subtracts one attention map from another to cancel what was spent on irrelevant content.

anchors.note_zh: 注意力之后给每个头加一个门。作者说注意力汇点因此减轻了。
anchors.note_en: A gate on each head after attention. The authors report weaker attention sinks.
